depiction_rules.notes: One demoness sent by Kamsa, shown in two source-grounded forms of the same character. D040 S004-S007 use the beautiful disguise; S008-S009 show her fallen giant true form, with both arms outstretched as the verse and caption describe. Her face, long dark hair, white flower, ear ornament and maroon-and-gold upper drape carry across both forms so that the giant reads as the same woman.

visual_bible.face: composed oval face with large almond eyes, arched brows, a red bindi and a small maang-tikka; a calm, alluring smile in disguise and a startled, wide-eyed expression when the poison is drawn out
visual_bible.skin: warm light-brown in disguise; muted grey-green in the giant true form
visual_bible.hair: very long, loose, wavy dark hair falling below the waist, adorned with white flowers behind one ear
visual_bible.build: ordinary adult proportions with natural two-armed anatomy in disguise; in the giant form the body is immense in scale, but limbs stay proportionate and connected
visual_bible.clothing: Disguise: deep maroon sari with small gold floral dots and a gold border, a cream veil with an ochre border over the head, a gold bead necklace, round gold drop earrings, armlet and bangles. Giant form: the same maroon gold-bordered upper drape over a torn ochre-orange patterned lower cloth, with gold anklets and bangles.
visual_bible.continuity_markers: long loose dark hair with a white flower, maang-tikka, round gold earring and maroon-and-gold drape in both forms; cream veil only in disguise; grey-green skin only in the giant form

never: no horns, fangs, claws, extra limbs or grotesque features
no gore, wounds or injury close-ups
no exposed breast or sexualized framing; nursing stays covered and maternal in framing
do not style her as Yashoda or in Yashoda's cream, saffron or rose sari family
no duplicate Putana within one scene
no detached or disproportionate limbs in the giant form
source_basis: D040 caption 4 (intake/D040/photo-captions.txt#004): a beautiful woman with hair adorned with flowers. Caption 8 (#008): she falls with a thunderous sound, both hands stretched, reverting to her huge demoness form.
